activities.name: Lookup File Record and Target Host
activities.description: Lookup defined target file-path, filename from INGEST.RDBMS_REFERENCE_TABLE and host URL from

activities.name: Count and Unique Fail Check
activities.description: The count starts at 0 and increments with each run.N2. On the 3rd run, the count will reach 2 (since counting starts from 0).N3. activities.name: Dummy Wait
activities.description: To improve pipeline resilience, a dummy 'Wait' activity is selectively attached to logger activities that are at the end of an execution path (a 'dead-end'). If one of these terminal logging calls fails, the error is gracefully caught by the 'Wait' activity. This prevents the logging issue from marking the entire pipeline as 'Failed' while ensuring that no subsequent, dependent activities are skipped. The Wait time in seconds value should be either 0 or 1.
